# Adversarial review — Evidence Ladder REFUTED drivers
Semantic pattern: **state transition with guards + attack gate funnel** -> visual types: **state machine** + **flowchart** * the 29-attack map * verified at HEAD `ac770f7`
Driver 1 — ratified proposal REJECT_BRANCH approved; ratification re-verified Driver 2 — obligation climbs completed obligations = ratification, no agent intent Driver 3 — bare classification digest-valid record alone = falsification fact THE GATE FUNNEL (fail-closed per row — every ✗ is a skip, never a crash) G1 project scoping ✗ #4 #15 foreign project G2 digest identity (id == artifact_id) ✗ #1 forged id G3 content integrity (F13 re-derive hash) ✗ #2 #3 #7 rewrite G4 class + falsification predicate ✗ #8–#14 classes/constraints G5 program + hypothesis resolution ✗ #5 #6 #16 #17 foreign/stale G6 terminal + F12 applied-transition check ✗ #21–#24 dup/tamper REFUTED — applied (terminal) never downgraded; a tampered cache is HEALED back to REFUTED with a note (F12) only repairs: upward tamper → derived rung; downward tamper of applied → healed all gates pass → apply (row + event, own transaction) Drivers 1/2 refusals ✗ #25 corrupt proposal ✗ #26 missing ratification ✗ #27 rejected · #28 wrong action ✗ #29 stale/foreign ratification all → note + nothing applied (AC-2) PRINCIPLE: stored ladder state is a CACHE, never the source of truth desired state derives only from ratified facts (satisfaction links · ratified REJECT_BRANCH proposals · digest-valid decisive falsifications). REFUTED is terminal and cannot be silently downgraded (#22); F8 bounds the RefutedApplied payload; F9 makes one-transition schema-level. Attack numbers refer to the 29-attack map in hermes_current_epistemic_architecture_review.md §C.2 — every attack is test-pinned (tests/test_q05_evidence_ladder.py).
